# Joice

> Joice is an iOS voice-journaling app. You talk out loud about whatever is on your mind and an AI companion listens like a friend — asking gentle follow-up questions, never giving unsolicited advice. Entries are transcribed and searchable, recurring life themes are surfaced over time, and each week Joice writes you a warm reflection on what you talked about. It is private and encrypted, free to try, and aimed at people who find blank pages hard but talking easy.

Joice is available for iOS. Download: https://joiceapp.com/#download

## Blog — the joice journal

Essays on journaling, mental health, and finding your way — from the makers of Joice, the voice journal that talks back.
Machine-readable index: https://joiceapp.com/blog/posts.json
RSS: https://joiceapp.com/blog/feed.xml

- [why saying your feelings out loud actually works](https://joiceapp.com/blog/why-saying-it-out-loud-works/): Naming an emotion quiets the brain's alarm system. The research behind talking to yourself, and why a voice memo can do what a blank page can't.
